title: Trading Operations SLOs
description: Service-level objectives for the order path, freshness and the kill switch (frontend plan §11 q4). Generated by scripts/gen-slo.py from monitoring/prometheus/slo/trading-slos.yaml.

options.content: Each SLO is a **30-day** objective. **SLI** is the measured ratio; **budget** is what is left of the allowed error (1 − burn over 30 d); **burn 1h / 6h** is how fast the budget is being spent right now (1× = exactly on budget, 14.4× pages). Event SLIs (orders, decisions) are gated on a minimum number of events because this platform trades a few times a day; the per-event alerts in *Trading Risk Operations* remain the guard below that volume. Definitions, sources and what to do: `docs/runbooks/TRADING-SLO.md`.

panels.title: Tick-to-trade latency
panels.description: 99 % of signal-to-order decisions reach the exchange acknowledgement within 5 s

panels.title: Signal freshness at decision
panels.description: 99 % of decisions act on a signal younger than 10 s

panels.title: Pre-trade risk gate availability
panels.description: 99.9 % of pre-trade checks evaluate (allowed or blocked); an error fails closed and counts against the budget

panels.title: Order acceptance at the OMS
panels.description: 95 % of orders created are not rejected for validation or exchange reasons (risk rejections are the gate doing its job and are excluded)

panels.title: Fill quality (implementation shortfall)
panels.description: 90 % of executed orders fill within 25 bps of the price the strategy decided on (arrival slippage, before fees)

panels.title: OMS-exchange reconciliation freshness
panels.description: 99.5 % of the time the exchange order sync and the fill poll each succeeded within the last 120 s

panels.title: Market-data freshness
panels.description: 99.5 % of the time the newest trade from the exchange stream is younger than 120 s

panels.title: Kill-switch readiness
panels.description: 99.9 % of the time every live trading-engine watches at least one halt file and evaluated them within the last 30 s
